MTM: Existing mark source/contract must independently admit funded positions before Capital replay. This EOD contract creates no interpolation, forward fill or new mark cadence.
cash_release_timestamp: For a valid historical reference full-fill: max(reference fill label, source assumed_available_at). No release on intent or no-fill. Runtime only broker full-fill confirmation.
endpoint: initial cash - q*effectiveBuy + q*effectiveSell, broker commission0. tradePnL=q*(effectiveSell-effectiveBuy). No second execution fee subtraction.
exception_gate: Any unresolved same-day candidate retained; no silent exclusion/partial portfolio. Require full C2 admission or STOP source/exception; no new funded-only censoring.
fill_semantics: Historical full-quantity reference fill under explicitly authorized EOD research model; market bar proves a reference trade, not actual SOR order execution/available depth. Runtime requires broker full-fill cumulative quantity confirmation.
frozen_cash_time: Old Frozen reference and assumed_available_at are retained in their original columns; new downstream cash event is a separately precommitted knowledge-clock binding.
historical_confirmation_time: Inherited completed-bar assumption at source minute+1m; conservative reference cash availability >= assumed source completion. Actual historical provider arrival UNKNOWN. No backdate to minute-start.
no_fill: EOD_UNEXECUTED_FAIL_CLOSED; cash_release_timestamp=null, proceeds=null, qty obligation retained. Outcome-based pre-entry filtering prohibited.
quantity: full remaining quantity, symbolic before allocator; no fabricated funded quantity. Isolated100-share calculations are accounting checks only.
reference_time: Frozen prior-fill reference unchanged; EOD first-trade minute start or exact15:30 auction.
same_time_order: Known confirmed EXIT cash release, marks, then ENTRY; unknown/no-fill cash release prohibited. Intent must precede post-intent execution micro-event even for15:20 bar.
